title: No Cooldown On Some Items
features:
No Cooldown On
--Смартфон Vivo
--Black Hole
--Ice Bucket Challenge
--geometry dash
Also Removing AutoClicker Script
script:
game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts["Anti-Autoclicker"]:Remove()
local mouse = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("ice bucket challenge") then
        local ohVector31 = mouse.Hit.p
        game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character["ice bucket challenge"].RemoteEvent:FireServer(ohVector31)
    end
end)
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Чёрная дыра") then
        local ohVector31 = mouse.Hit.p
        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character[utf8.char(1063, 1105, 1088, 1085, 1072, 1103, 32, 1076, 1099, 1088, 1072)].Fire:FireServer(ohVector31)
    end
end)
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Смартфон Vivo") then
        local ohVector31 = mouse.Hit.p
        game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character[utf8.char(1057, 1084, 1072, 1088, 1090, 1092, 1086, 1085, 32, 86, 105, 118, 111)].Brosok:FireServer(ohVector31)
    end
end)
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("geometry dash") then
        local ohVector31 = mouse.Hit.p
		game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character["geometry dash"].Fire:FireServer(ohVector31)
    end
end)
